image_description: Two fabric baby bibs lying flat on a white surface. The bib on the left features a grey textured body with a colorful striped pocket (pink, orange, purple) and a red patterned upper section. The bib on the right has a grey body with a white graphic print, a blue patterned upper section with cartoon characters, and a small red circular detail near the neck. Both have dark blue binding around the edges.
